purpose: 参考画像を受けた、太い輪郭線・簡略化した衣装・少ない色面のティナ画風案
prompt:
Edit the previously shown Tina style-study portrait into a MUCH SIMPLER, bold-outline anime/manga game character sprite.
Input images: the earlier Tina portraits are character-identity references only. The LAST image (a browser screenshot of a narrow Japanese fantasy-game ensemble poster) is the visual direction reference: borrow only its economical anime design, large clear eyes, strong silhouettes and flat cel colors. Do not reproduce its characters, lettering, ensemble or layout.
Primary request: Produce ONE original Tina bust/waist-up standing portrait with significantly thicker clean black/dark-brown outlines, simplified shapes and bright flat cel colors. This is a LIGHTWEIGHT style study.
Character identity: Tina, a 19-year-old ADULT woman, confident and caring guild swordswoman; RED high ponytail, AMBER eyes, small rectangular adhesive bandage on one cheek. A cheerful, slightly headstrong closed-mouth smile. Slightly stylized anime proportions with a larger expressive head and eyes, but not a toddler or tiny chibi.
Simplification is the main objective: hair is drawn as 5–7 large solid locks, not dozens of strands. Use bold smooth outer contours and very few internal lines. Skin: one flat base tone plus a SINGLE simple cel-shadow tone. Hair: red base plus a SINGLE dark-red shadow shape and at most ONE simple highlight shape. Eyes: large readable amber irises, one simple white glint each. No intricate eye rendering.
Clothing: an ivory blouse with just a few large fold lines; ONE plain brown/light-steel chest protector represented as simple flat shapes, TWO simple leather shoulder straps. No rows of buckles, rivets, decorative seams, lace, texture or realistic metal reflections. Keep shoulders covered and clothing functional and wholesome.
Style: cheerful early-2000s Japanese fantasy RPG anime/manga character design, thick smooth clean outlines, limited bright palette, graphic flat cel shading, an easily recognizable silhouette when reduced to 200 pixels. Much less detailed than ALL previous Tina images. No painterly rendering, gradients, realistic lighting, hatching, scratchy sketch lines, fabric/metal textures, glossy materials or fine hair strands.
Composition: square canvas, ONE character from the complete top of the hair to the waist, relaxed standing conversation pose with slight three-quarter torso turn, looking toward the viewer. Leave a clear generous margin above the ENTIRE ponytail; no clipping of the head or hair. Face around the upper third. Flat pale cream background. No text, labels, frames, watermark, extra characters, extra props or panels.
